opportunities.title: Evaluate humanoid balance and whole-body coordination
opportunities.summary: Run supervised walking, posture and coordinated-joint experiments in a controlled laboratory, with a defined fall boundary and researcher-controlled stop conditions.

reviewLinks.rationale: The EDU configuration permits secondary development; manufacturer motion-control features and the German research listing support balance and coordination experiments.
limitations: Platform application claim, not a completed stability benchmark.
No material-transport or production task is implied.

reviewLinks.rationale: The exact reference design combines the programmable body with whole-body control and simulation-to-hardware research tools.
limitations: Researchers must implement and validate the experiment.
No certified stability envelope or safe proximity to people is established.

opportunities.title: Study fingertip contact during humanoid grasps
opportunities.summary: Use tactile hands to examine contact signals and controlled grasps, then measure experimental outcomes under researcher supervision.

reviewLinks.rationale: The official reference specifies dual tactile Sharpa Wave hands and supports dexterous-manipulation research.
limitations: Requires the specified hands; the handless Smart package is not equivalent.
Sensor specifications are not a proven grasp-success rate or industrial workcell.
